titel: Egg whites with and without fat
kurz: A tiny drop of egg yolk stops egg whites from whipping stiff.
bild_im_kopf: Like blowing soap bubbles with greasy fingers: a little fat, and no bubble holds.
beobachtung: Without fat you get stiff, glossy whites. With the drop of fat it stays runny or soft and foamy.
erklaerung: The proteins form a skin around the air bubbles. Fat pushes in between, and the bubbles burst.
schritte: Put one egg white in each bowl.
Add a tiny drop of egg yolk or oil to one bowl.
Whisk both for the same length of time.
material: a drop of egg yolk or oil
